text:
## Abstract  
Ciprofloxacin resistance in Escherichia coli is a critical public-health concern, and locating publicly available data sets on this topic supports meta-analysis and surveillance. We queried the NIH NIAID-sponsored National Database of EID‐related Data (Next Generation Data Enterprise; NDE), which federates >14 million records from ~55 biomedical repositories, to enumerate “studies” (datasets) that mention ciprofloxacin and are annotated to the pathogen Escherichia coli. Using the `nde_search_datasets` tool with filters `infectiousAgent.name:"Escherichia coli"` and free-text term “ciprofloxacin”, restricted to records whose schema.org `@type` is “Dataset”, we retrieved the total count of matching datasets. The search returned 391 datasets (with one representative record previewed). This figure provides an upper bound on ciprofloxacin-related E. coli studies currently indexed by NDE and highlights the substantial volume of publicly available resources for investigating antimicrobial resistance mechanisms, epidemiology, and treatment outcomes in this pathogen.

## I. Introduction  
Background.  Ciprofloxacin, a fluoroquinolone antibiotic, is widely used to treat infections caused by Escherichia coli. Rising resistance threatens its clinical utility, necessitating comprehensive surveillance and data sharing.  
Literature Review.  No literature was retrieved for this query.  
Knowledge Gap.  The exact number of publicly accessible ciprofloxacin-related E. coli studies across global biomedical repositories was not known.  
Objective & Hypothesis.  We aimed to quantify how many datasets concerning ciprofloxacin and Escherichia coli are currently catalogued in the NDE; we expected that the federated index would reveal hundreds of such datasets.

## II. Materials and Methods  
Study Design.  A single resource, the NDE federated index, was queried to count datasets annotated for both “ciprofloxacin” and Escherichia coli.  
Materials.  
• NDE (queried via `nde_search_datasets`).  
Procedures.  
1. Called `nde_search_datasets` with:  
   • query = "ciprofloxacin"  
   • pathogen = "Escherichia coli"  
   • record_type = "Dataset"  
   • size = 1 (to minimize payload)  
   • offset = 0  
Statistical Analysis.  The `total` field returned by NDE represents the number of distinct records matching the query. No further calculations were required.

## III. Results  
Data Presentation.  (Table 1)

| Query | Pathogen filter | Record type | Total datasets |
|-------|-----------------|-------------|----------------|
| ciprofloxacin | Escherichia coli | Dataset | 391 |

Findings.  The NDE index contained 391 datasets that reference “ciprofloxacin” and are annotated to the pathogen Escherichia coli.

## IV. Discussion  
Interpretation.  The presence of 391 datasets indicates a rich volume of publicly available studies investigating ciprofloxacin in the context of E. coli.  
Context.  Although no primary literature was directly retrieved in this query, the dataset count alone suggests extensive research activity and data deposition across multiple repositories (e.g., Figshare, NCBI SRA, GEO).  
Limitations.  The NDE aggregates metadata from partner repositories; records not yet harvested or lacking explicit “ciprofloxacin” or E. coli annotations are not counted. The term “study” was operationalized as schema.org `Dataset`; some experimental series may instead be catalogued as “Sample” or other record types and thus excluded.  
Conclusion & Future Directions.  At least 391 ciprofloxacin-related E. coli datasets are available for secondary analysis. Future work could (i) classify these datasets by assay type (e.g., RNA-seq, WGS, MIC measurements) via NDE faceting, and (ii) integrate functional genomics and phenotypic data to map resistance determinants.

## References  
[1] NDE Dataset Search. https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=ciprofloxacin+AND+%40type%3A%22Dataset%22+AND+infectiousAgent.name%3A%22Escherichia+coli%22&size=1&_source=_id%2C%40type%2Cname%2Cdescription%2Curl%2Cdoi%2Cidentifier%2Cdate%2CdatePublished%2CdateModified%2CincludedInDataCatalog.name%2CincludedInDataCatalog.url%2CincludedInDataCatalog.archivedAt%2Cauthor.name%2CinfectiousAgent.name%2CinfectiousAgent.displayName%2Cspecies.name%2ChealthCondition.name%2CmeasurementTechnique.name%2CtopicCategory.name%2Ckeywords%2CconditionsOfAccess%2Clicense%2Cdistribution.contentUrl%2CsourceOrganization.name%2Cfunding.funder.name%2CprogrammingLanguage%2CapplicationCategory%2CoperatingSystem%2CsoftwareVersion%2CcodeRepository%2CisBasedOn.identifier%2CvariableMeasured.name%2Cvalue%2CunitText%2CmarginOfError.name%2CmarginOfError.value%2CobservationAbout.name%2CobservationAbout.identifier%2CmeasuredProperty.name%2CobservationType.name%2CmeasurementQualifier%2CsubjectOf.identifier
